title: Re-timings of classes of places: which relative factors of clock rates are detectable

key_results.statement: For any set of read classes, $((a_\ell),C')$ is an equivalence iff (I) $\Pi^{C'}(a_\ell\lambda)=\Pi^{C}(\lambda)$ for all place projectors of read classes and (II) the evolved place projectors of two read classes with $a_\ell\neq a_{\ell'}$ commute at all $\lambda,\lambda'$.

Necessary: $[C-a_\ell C',\Pi]=0$ and $[[C,C'],\Pi]=0$ for place projectors of read classes; sufficient: $[C-a_\ell C',\Pi]=0$ for read classes and $[C,C']=0$; if every class is read the equivalence holds iff $[C-a_\ell C',\Pi]=0$ for all classes and $[C,C']=0$.

Entry form with every class read: (E1) each nonzero off-diagonal entry of $C$ touches classes of one factor group only, (E2) $[C^{[i]},C^{[i']}]=0$, (E3) $C'=C'^{\rm d}+\sum_iC^{[i]}/\alpha_i$ with $[C^{\rm d}-\alpha_iC'^{\rm d},C^{[i]}]=0$, (E4) $C'^{\rm d}$ is a sum of pair terms.
At given factors $C'$ is unique up to a real diagonal sum of pair terms $D$ with $[C,D]=0$ (constant on the components of the transition graph); with all factors equal to $\alpha$, $C'=C/\alpha+D$.

Two classes have equal factors in every equivalence if (T1) a nonzero entry of $C$ touches both, (T2) they are joined by a chain of such links, or (T3) $[C^{\langle\ell\rangle},C^{\langle\ell'\rangle}]$ has a nonzero entry on a pair touching both; sufficient, not necessary.

An equivalence with factor $\alpha$ on $\mathcal G$ and $\alpha'\neq\alpha$ elsewhere exists iff $C=F_{\mathcal G}+F_{\bar{\mathcal G}}$ is a commuting pair-term split along $\mathcal G$; then $C'=F_{\mathcal G}/\alpha+F_{\bar{\mathcal G}}/\alpha'$ up to the term of (5.5).

If $C=\sum_iF_i$ with commuting pair-term $F_i$ that commute with the place projectors of all read classes outside the group $\mathcal G_i$, then $C'=\sum_iF_i/\alpha_i$ with $a_\ell=\alpha_i$ on $\mathcal G_i$ is an equivalence for all $\alpha_i>0$.

A reading with one outcome per block equals the yes/no readings of all blocks at one $\lambda$: $Q_i\prod_{j\neq i}(\mathbb 1-Q_j)=Q_i$ and all other outcome strings have probability zero; unequal factors spread it over several values of the parameter.

Body on a chain with hopping on every bond: all positions have one factor $a_b$ (medium read or not); $a_c=a_b$ iff $X$ is not diagonal, $a_c$ free if $X$ is diagonal; $C'=C/a_b+\Delta$ with $\Delta=\sum_{\epsilon,\gamma}d_{\epsilon\gamma}\Pi_\epsilon\otimes\Pi_\gamma$.
Body without hopping, $\tau=0$: all factors $a_x>0$, $a_c>0$ occur with $C'=\sum_xF_x/a_x+F_c/a_c+\Delta$; no relative factor is detectable, with the medium read or not, for $X$ diagonal or not.
For $\tau=0$ the choice $a_x=\eta_x$ gives an equivalent contract of the class $\mathcal C$ with the flat clock profile $\eta'_x=1$, $m'_x=m_x/\eta_x$, $V'_x=V_x/\eta_x$ and the same records.

Class-form equivalences with hopping: $\tau'\zeta'_x=\tau\zeta_x/a_b$, $\eta'_x/\lambda'_0=\eta_x/(a_b\lambda_0)$, $m'_x=m_x/a_b+(-1)^xy_1$, $V'_x=V_x/a_b+y_0-\beta x$, $\kappa'X'=\kappa X/a_b+\beta\mathbb 1$.

Class-form equivalences without hopping: $\eta'_x/\lambda'_0=\eta_x/(a_x\lambda_0)$, $m'_x=m_x/a_x+y_{1,x}$, $V'_x=V_x/a_x+y_{0,x}$, $\kappa'X'=\kappa X/a_c+\tilde Y+\beta\mathbb 1$ with $[\tilde Y,X]=0$.

Under the conventions K1, K2: with hopping $\eta_x/\eta_y$, $\tau\zeta_x/\eta_x$, $(V_x-V_y)/\eta_x$ are the same in every equivalence, $m_x/\eta_x$ is not (staggered shift) and the tick is multiplied by $a_b$; without hopping only $\tau\zeta_x/\eta_x=0$ is the same.

Two runs: with hopping the ratio $r_W(x_1)/r_W(x_2)$ and $\eta_{x_1}/\eta_{x_2}$ are the same in every equivalent description; for $\tau=0$ the ratio becomes $(\eta_{x_1}/\eta_{x_2})(a_{x_2}/a_{x_1})$, any positive number.

Two bodies and a common medium, all read: the table of all equivalences; the relative factor of the two bodies is detectable iff $X$ is not diagonal in the places of the medium and $[C_1,\hat x_1]\neq0$ and $[C_2,\hat x_2]\neq0$.

Medium not read: $C'=C_1/a_1+C_2/a_2+(\kappa_1/a_1)\hat x_1\otimes X+(\kappa_2/a_2)\hat x_2\otimes X$ is an equivalence for all $a_1,a_2>0$ and every $C_1,C_2,\kappa_1,\kappa_2,X$; the relative factor of the two bodies is not detectable.

Under (5.20): $(\lambda_1,\lambda_2)\mapsto(a_1\lambda_1,a_2\lambda_2)$, $C_i\mapsto C_i/a_i$, $\kappa_i\mapsto\kappa_i/a_i$; pairing at equal $\lambda$ and equality of parameters of two types are not preserved, ratios within one type are.

open_issues: When some classes are not read, the exact set of equivalences lies between the necessary and the sufficient conditions of (5.3); the complete list of contracts in item 2(a) with the medium not read is open, the detectability answers do not depend on it.
The conditions (T1)–(T3) are sufficient, not necessary; for three or more objects the A5 condition on the diagonal part, (E4) and (S4), is not reduced to a condition on entries.
For three or more distinct factors (5.8) is proven as sufficient only.
Item 4(b) is shown for starts inside one block; for a spread start at τ=0 the clock reading at one λ is not mapped to a clock reading at one value of the parameter.
The answers of item 2(c) depend on the conventions K1 (multiple of the identity in X) and K2 (division of η_x/λ_0 into η_x and λ_0).
Not treated, out of scope: re-timings not linear in λ, instances of one type, readings not local to one object, comparison by transport or by a signal.

consistency_checks.check: Chain of two positions with a two-place clock and a two-place medium: with hopping the second-order probabilities force a_0=a_1, the staggered shift m_0→m_0+y_1, m_1→m_1−y_1 is an equivalence, X=σ_1 ties the medium and X=σ_3 leaves it free; without hopping p_λ(a=1)=sin²(πη_xλ/2λ_0) is reproduced at a_xλ and the two-run ratio changes from η_0/η_1 to 1.
C diagonal in the joint places: every re-timing with a diagonal C' is an equivalence, statistics do not depend on any λ, no relative factor is detectable.
